# RevolutClient v1.0.0 - Table of Contents

Production-grade Elixir SDK for the complete Revolut Developer API — Merchant, Business, Open Banking, Crypto Ramp, and Crypto Exchange.

## Pages

- [RevolutClient](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [RevolutClient.HTTPBehaviour](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.HTTPBehaviour.md): Behaviour that the HTTP adapter must implement.
Swap this in tests via `Mox` or point `:http_client` to a stub module.

- [RevolutClient.ReqHTTP](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.ReqHTTP.md): Default HTTP adapter backed by the `Req` library.

- [RevolutClient.TokenBucket](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.TokenBucket.md): Token-bucket rate limiter backed by a `GenServer`.
- [RevolutClient.Types.PageResponse](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Types.PageResponse.md): Cursor-based page response wrapping a list of items.

- Core
  - [RevolutClient](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.md): `RevolutClient` — Production-grade Elixir SDK for the complete Revolut Developer API.
  - [RevolutClient.Client](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Client.md): Core HTTP transport layer shared by all API sub-clients.
  - [RevolutClient.Config](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Config.md): Configuration for a `RevolutClient.Client`.

- API Clients
  - [RevolutClient.Business](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Business.md): Revolut Business API client.
  - [RevolutClient.CryptoExchange](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.CryptoExchange.md): Revolut X (Crypto Exchange) API client.
  - [RevolutClient.CryptoRamp](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.CryptoRamp.md): Revolut Crypto Ramp Partner API client (v2).
  - [RevolutClient.Merchant](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Merchant.md): Revolut Merchant API client — `api_version: 2025-12-04`.
  - [RevolutClient.OpenBanking](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.OpenBanking.md): Revolut Open Banking API client (OB v3.1).

- Webhooks
  - [RevolutClient.Webhook](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Webhook.md): Type-safe, stateless webhook event dispatcher.
  - [RevolutClient.Webhook.Crypto](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Webhook.Crypto.md): HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for Revolut webhook payloads.

- Types &amp; Errors
  - [RevolutClient.Error](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Error.md): Structured error types returned by all RevolutClient API calls.
  - [RevolutClient.Types](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Types.md): Shared types, value objects, and pagination helpers used across all API modules.

- Exceptions
  - [RevolutClient.Error.API](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Error.API.md): Raised when Revolut returns a non-2xx HTTP status code.
  - [RevolutClient.Error.Configuration](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Error.Configuration.md): SDK misconfiguration (missing keys, invalid URLs, etc.).
  - [RevolutClient.Error.Network](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Error.Network.md): Transport-level failure (timeout, DNS failure, TLS error, etc.).
  - [RevolutClient.Error.Serialization](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Error.Serialization.md): JSON encoding or decoding failure.
  - [RevolutClient.Error.Validation](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Error.Validation.md): Invalid argument caught before sending a request.
  - [RevolutClient.Error.Webhook](https://revolut-client.hexdocs.pm/RevolutClient.Error.Webhook.md): Invalid webhook signature or malformed payload.
